description: This file defines the WeakPasswordResetController class, which handles password reset functionality for weak passwords within the authentication module of the OrangeHRM system. It manages the validation of reset codes, prepares components with necessary properties, and interacts with services like CSRF token management and password strength validation.

classes.name: WeakPasswordResetController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the weak password reset process, including validation and preparing the password reset component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the password reset component before rendering, including validation of the reset code, setting necessary properties, and handling error states.
